creator: Alexander Terp
description: 22efc8e9 and 925923c5 end a Claude Code Stop hook's `muster msg wait --due` when its pane closes (refusal pane_closed) or the agent starts a new turn (new_turn), both exit 1, which the hook `wait --due >&2 && exit 2; exit 0` should treat as an ordinary end. That reading was checked against the hook text, not a real Claude Code. The --claude-code tier could close a hooked pane and start a second turn and check the hook's wait process is gone and no 'Stop hook feedback' arrived.
title: ./dev --claude-code does not check that a Stop hook's msg wait ends on a pane close or a new turn
